shapeSummary: Flat aluminum servo frame, 43 mm (X) by 65 mm (Z) by 12 mm tall (Y), bottom at Y=0. It has a central rectangular window of 23 x 41 mm. Four 4.5 mm through-holes are drilled vertically in the rails. Two blind 4 mm tapped-hole stand-ins are in the end bars, and two 4 mm blind holes are drilled into the side faces at opposite ends. The holes are plain cylinders with no threads.
warnings: Only the 43 mm width comes from product data, and the source marks it as unverified. The 65 mm length and 12 mm thickness are estimates from the analysis.
The stepped and offset corner tabs and notches visible in the render are omitted and replaced by a plain rectangular outline.
The window size (23 x 41 mm) is estimated.
Hole positions and counts are approximate. The 32 mm and 24 mm hole patterns from the description are not confirmed.
The extra tapped holes visible on the tab faces and end faces are only partly modeled.
Threads, the included screws and the included washers are not modeled.

t = 12.0
